text:
Ava Chen: Ok team — holiday challenge time! 🎄 Tiny ornament scavenger hunt across desks. I hid 10 little red bells around the office. First hint: `Under something that hums but doesn't sing.` Reply with pics when you find one! :mag_right:
Miguel R: Wait so this is IRL only? I'm remote in Austin :wave:
Ava Chen: Mostly office-only, but remote folks can join the virtual clue channel and trade puzzle points. We'll ship stickers. :ship:
Sasha Patel: Rules? Are we allowed to peek into Melanie's plant stand? 😅
Ava Chen: Yes but be gentle. No moving other people's stuff. Post photo + desk location (room/floor) to claim. One ornament per person. :point_down:
Noah: On my way. Clue 1 solved — it's on a UPS box humming by the printer. pic: http://imgur.com/desk-bell-1.jpg :camera_with_flash:
Jules: Found one behind the standing desk fan in eng-platform 3rd floor! pic: http://imgur.com/jules-bell.jpg :tada:
Miguel R: I ship a cardboard cutout of my cat to participate. Will that count? :cat2:
Ava Chen: If it has a bell in the pic yes :grin:
decor-bot: Leaderboard update: 1) Jules (1), 2) Noah (1). Remaining ornaments: 8. :clipboard:
Sasha Patel: Clue 2 please? :eyes:
Ava Chen: Clue 2: `It keeps your coffee warm but sometimes judges your mug choice.`
Miguel R: Thinking thermos. I'll check the kitchen cams (jk). :coffee:
Noah: Photo from Clue 2: behind the community kettle. pic: http://imgur.com/noah-bell-2.jpg — tag me for a sticker :raised_hands:
Jules: Congrats Noah! Also here's a cozy GIF :http://giphy.com/cozy-xmas
Ava Chen: OK final hint for the day: `You pass it on your way to stand-ups, often adorned with a lanyard.`
Sasha Patel: Lobby reception plant? I'll swing by tomorrow morning.
Miguel R: Managed to recruit Leila's desk plant proxy: she reports zero bells found but sends vibes. :seedling:
decor-bot: Leaderboard update: 1) Jules (1), 2) Noah (2). Remaining ornaments: 6. Prize: limited-edition Redwood enamel pin. :sparkles:
Jules: Tiny victory dance in #random. :dancer: :trophy:
Ava Chen: Thanks for playing! Drop questions here. We'll run a remote-puzzle version next week for folks out of office. Happy holidays early everyone :snowflake:
Noah: Happy holidays! :evergreen_tree:
Sasha Patel: This is my favorite kind of low-stakes chaos. :laughing:
Miguel R: Pics incoming later — will bribe roommate to be a proxy. :grimacing:
decor-bot: Thread closed for today. Automated reminder to claim prizes by Dec 20. :bell:
